props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every read goes through it, so widgets on a page share one cache.

props.name: work_context
props.meaning: The project, row and task on show.

props.name: current_user
props.meaning: Whose assigned tasks the second section lists.

props.name: recent_limit
props.meaning: How many recents survive a change.

props.name: thumbnail
props.meaning: Field holding a task row's thumbnail URL. A task with no picture falls back to its glyph.

props.name: label_field
props.meaning: Field holding a task row's label.

props.name: sub_label_field
props.meaning: The muted line under the label. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: The muted line of your own. Wins over `subLabelField`.

props.name: secondary_field
props.meaning: The right-aligned value, drawn by its data type.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: Right-aligned text of your own. Wins over `secondaryField`.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Shows the row's `code` beside the label when the two differ.

props.name: fields
props.meaning: Extra fields to request, so your own sub-label or secondary can read them.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Trigger heights 7, 8 and 9, and the chips inside it.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the person has no task assigned.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

events.name: work_context_changed
events.when: The project, entity or task changed.

events.name: recents_changed
events.when: The recents list changed, the newest first.

events.name: open_changed
events.when: The popover opened or closed. Svelte also binds it with `bind:open`.

keyboard.does: Opens the popover from the trigger, and picks the row under focus.
Moves through the recents, the assigned tasks and into the tree.
Moves through the tree, once focus is in its input.
Opens the level below a tree row, and goes back up.
Moves the highlight, through a load-more page.
Takes the highlighted row, or reads the next page on the load-more row.
Closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger.
